description: This file implements core server connection management functions for a web server, including connection creation, reset, close, reading, writing, and event handling, as well as connection lifecycle management such as accepting new connections and periodic maintenance.

classes.name: connection
classes.description: Represents a server client connection with associated state and resource management.

classes.name: request_st
classes.description: Holds request-specific data and state for an active connection.

methods.name: connection * connections_get_new_connection(server * srv)
methods.description: Creates or reuses a connection object from the pool or by initializing a new one.

methods.name: void connection_del(server * srv,connection * con)
methods.description: Removes a connection from the server's connection list and moves it to the pool.

methods.name: void connection_close(connection * con)
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a connection, including socket and internal state.

methods.name: void connection_read_for_eos(connection * const con)
methods.description: Reads all remaining data on a connection after EOF, handling plain and SSL sockets.

methods.name: void connection_handle_close_state(connection * con)
methods.description: Handles cleanup and timeout of a connection in close state.

methods.name: void connection_handle_shutdown(connection * con)
methods.description: Shuts down a connection gracefully, optionally sending a shutdown signal.

methods.name: void connection_handle_request_start_state(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Initializes request state when starting to process a new request.

methods.name: void connection_handle_response_end_state(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Finalizes request processing, handles connection keep-alive or shutdown.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ off_t connection_write_throttle(const connection * const con,off_t max_bytes)
methods.description: Calculates how many bytes can be written respecting rate limits.

methods.name: int connection_write_chunkqueue(connection * const con,chunkqueue * const restrict cq,off_t max_bytes)
methods.description: Writes data from a chunkqueue to a connection, respecting throttling.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int connection_handle_write(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Handles attempting to write data to a connection, handles partial writes and errors.

methods.name: int connection_handle_write_state(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Manages the write state machine including handling of event readiness.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_returns_nonnull__ connection * connection_init(server * srv)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new connection object.

methods.name: void connection_free(connection * const con)
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with a connection object.

methods.name: void connections_pool_clear(server * const srv)
methods.description: Clears and frees all pooled connection objects.

methods.name: void connections_free(server * srv)
methods.description: Frees all active and pooled connection objects.

methods.name: void connection_reset(connection * con)
methods.description: Resets the state of a connection to an initial state for reuse.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void connection_transition_h2(request_st * const h2r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Transitions a request to HTTP/2 protocol mode.

methods.name: handler_t connection_handle_fdevent(void * const context,const int revents)
methods.description: Handles file descriptor events for a connection.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int connection_read_cq_err(connection * con)
methods.description: Handles errors during reading chunkqueue data.

methods.name: int connection_read_cq(connection * con,chunkqueue * cq,off_t max_bytes)
methods.description: Reads data into a connection's chunkqueue from socket.

methods.name: int connection_write_cq(connection * con,chunkqueue * cq,off_t max_bytes)
methods.description: Writes data from a connection's chunkqueue to socket.

methods.name: connection * connection_accepted(server * srv,const server_socket * srv_socket,sock_addr * cnt_addr,int cnt)
methods.description: Accepts a new incoming connection and initializes the connection object.

methods.name: void connection_state_machine(connection * const con)
methods.description: Executes the connection's state machine, progressing request/response handling.

methods.name: void connection_check_timeout(connection * const con,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Checks for connection timeouts and manages connection state accordingly.

methods.name: void connection_periodic_maint(server * const srv,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Performs periodic maintenance on all server connections.

methods.name: void connection_graceful_shutdown_maint(server * const srv)
methods.description: Performs maintenance tasks for graceful shutdown of connections.
